# cb:b552

> Settle the transcript destination for non-plan-scale sessions and reconcile the docs to one rule. cb:b540 routes a decision-weight session's verbatim thread to plans/<set>/ when plan-scale, but a low-ceremony thread (e.g. doc maintenance) has no plan set; the /end skill conditions the transcript byte-copy on plan-scale work while docs/operations.md frames the /end snapshot as the standard record captured every close. The two read differently, and a non-plan session's verbatim transcript went uncopied this session until asked for, then was stored ad hoc beside its chronicle (chronicles/<slug>.jsonl, the chronicle serving as the readable summary, mirroring the plans/<set>/sessions/ convention). Codify the non-plan destination and align cb:b540, the /end skill (steps 5 and 7), and docs/operations.md to one rule, so the next session does not guess whether a transcript copy is due or where it lands.
